about:
AFL operates from its headquarters in Duncan, South Carolina, with additional cable manufacturing facilities in North Grafton, Massachusetts; Monterrey, Mexico; the United Kingdom; and Germany. The company traces its flagship product, optical ground wire (OPGW), to 1984, when it introduced the first OPGW for high‑voltage transmission lines.

AFL manufactures a full range of fiber optic cables, including OPGW (AlumaCore, CentraCore, HexaCore), ADSS (standard, mini‑span, flat drop, aerial drop), high‑density premise cables (MicroCore, armored tight‑buffered, hybrid fiber/copper), and harsh‑environment cables for subsea, downhole, and LSZH sensing applications. The company also produces attachment hardware, splice closures, tools, and assemblies. All cables are made to order, and AFL’s engineering team customizes designs for each application, supported by on‑site training and installation oversight. To date, AFL has supplied more than 250,000 km of OPGW worldwide and serves customers in over 100 countries.

Primary markets include electric utilities (transmission and distribution), broadband and telecommunications, enterprise and data‑center networks, industrial facilities, hyperscale data centers, and subsea/refinery operations. Customers range from investor‑owned utilities and rural cooperatives to private network operators and offshore energy companies.

AFL emphasizes environmental stewardship: its cable plants are ISO 14001 certified, recycling rates for paper, wood, metal, and plastic exceed 85 percent, and a returnable steel‑reel program reduces waste. The company also targets a yearly carbon‑footprint reduction of more than three percent. These practices, combined with custom engineering and field support, form the core of its differentiation.
